title: McBE: A Multi-task Chinese Bias Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the McBE benchmark through 5 tasks: Preference Computation (Negative Log-Likelihood variance across template substitutions), Subcategory Classification, Scenario Selection, Bias Analysis evaluated by an LLM-as-a-judge, and Bias Scoring compared to human annotations.
